title: How savings interest is calculated
statement: Savings Bank Account interest will be calculated on the daily balances maintained in your account.

title: Online NEFT charges and eligibility
statement: NEFT transactions done online are free (w.e.f. 1st Nov 2017) (Applicable to all retail savings/Salary/NR/Managed/Non-managed individual customers)

title: Stop payment on a cheque
statement: The Bank will accept Stop Payment Instruction from the depositors in respect of cheques issued by them.

title: Protecting OTP, PIN, CVV and passwords
statement: Never share OTP, PIN, CVV, passwords or card details.

title: Minimum tenure to earn interest on an NRE recurring deposit
statement: The minimum tenure for earning interest on an NRE Recurring Deposit is 1 year.

title: Which cheques qualify for Positive Pay
statement: This service is applicable only for cheque received under CTS clearing of Rs. 50,000/- and above.

title: Credit card usage controls in MyCards
statement: Enable Online/Contactless/International usage mode and set usage limits

title: Receiving money and UPI PIN safety
statement: UPI PIN is only required when you are sending money to someone. It is NEVER required when you receive money from someone.

title: Minimum RTGS transfer amount
statement: The RTGS (Real Time Gross Settlement) system is designed for high-value transactions, with a minimum transfer amount of ₹2 lakh.

title: What the fixed deposit calculator estimate excludes
statement: This is an approximate maturity amount. The final value may differ. Also, it does not include TDS deductions.
